purpose: Mark the approach of an awaited decisive stage.
keywords: Next week is finally my first recital.
The sky darkened, and the storm was now drawing near.
At last, it was time to leave.
restrictions: Often implies buildup, anticipation, or an intensifying situation.
mistake: Use 突然 for an event with no buildup.
